messages.subject: Content and Collaboration ideas
messages.summary: Good afternoon Stella, How are you? Just wanted to check in as we haven't spoken in about a week. I've been pretty busy lately. I spent a full day filming with Max, so I now have a lot of content to edit and upload over the coming weeks. We're also talking abo
messages.body:
Good afternoon Stella,

How are you? Just wanted to check in as we haven't spoken in about a week.

I've been pretty busy lately. I spent a full day filming with Max, so I now
have a lot of content to edit and upload over the coming weeks. We're also
talking about doing some future collaborations, which I think could make
for some really strong content on the channel.

Alongside that, I've got plans for some product reviews, tutorials, shorts
and streaming, so there's plenty in the pipeline.

I also wanted to follow up regarding the course. I've started putting it
together and have already had the first session with the student. I was
just wondering whether the Evo unit has been shipped to him yet and if you
have the tracking number?

Also, let me know when you have some free time. It would be great to catch
up and go over the course together.

Finally, a quick update on the Melbourne Junior tournament. The organiser
has purchased a Chessnut Move and has been showing it off around the club,
so that's been some nice promotion already. He's also shared the planned
venue layout with me, including the booth location and visibility, giving
us the best location right outside the playing hall.

Since the event is still a few months away, I was wondering whether you'd
be interested in having a pull-up banner made for the booth. If you're
happy with the idea, I can contact a few local printing companies and get
the dimensions and pricing. It looks like they'd cost around AUD $300–400.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Regards,
Wade

messages.body:
Hi Stella,

Thank you for the honest feedback! I completely understand that for
Chessnut, showcasing the tactile detail and craftsmanship of the board is
essential.

Much of my recent content has been optimized for screen-captured gameplay,
but for this collaboration, I’ll be switching to a high-resolution physical
setup. I have an iPhone 15, which allows for extremely sharp 4K close-up
shots. Additionally, if the project requires it, I have access to a
high-end dedicated camera to ensure the production value meets your exact
standards.

I’d be happy to film a quick 15-second test clip using this setup so you
can see the clarity and detail firsthand. Would that be helpful?

Best,
Chekmatelive

Hi Stella,

Long-term works for us, we'd rather build something ongoing than do a
one-off too.

To shape it properly, two things: what does the ongoing arrangement look
like on your side in terms of frequency and format, and is there budget
attached to it or is it gifted plus affiliate? Felu's happy to have the
board in his setup either way, but if we're talking regular integrations
then it's a paid arrangement and I'd want to put a proper structure to it.

Once I know what you have in mind I can come back with options.

Best,

messages.body:
Dear Stella,

I hope you're doing well.

I just wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding the potential
partnership between Chessnut and Al Ain Chess Club.

We remain very interested in exploring this collaboration and would
appreciate any updates regarding the sponsorship details when you have the
opportunity.

We look forward to hearing from you and hope to move forward together soon.

Thank you for your time.

> your vision for a long-term partnership.

> beginning of a valuable collaboration between Chessnut and Al Ain Chess
> Club.
>
> We are very interested in the product sponsorship model and the pre-order
> distribution approach, especially as it allows us to introduce Chessnut
> products to our community without the need to hold inventory.
>
> Before moving forward, we would appreciate a few additional details
> regarding:
>
> - The products included in the sponsorship (models and quantities).
> - The estimated annual value of the sponsorship.
> - Whether shipping costs to the UAE are covered by Chessnut.
> - The distributor margin and ordering process.
> - Whether the partnership is intended to be annual and include support
> for multiple tournaments and club activities throughout the year.
>
> Once we have these details, we will be pleased to discuss the next steps
> and work together to establish a successful long-term partnership.
>
> We look forward to your response and are excited about the potential
> opportunities this partnership can create for both Chessnut and Al Ain

messages.body:
Hi Stella,

Our main goal is not only to achieve good results during this event, but
also to build a successful collaboration model that we can replicate and
improve together in future tournaments. We see Valdepeñas as an opportunity
to create a real success story and learn what works best for both Chessnut
and ChessMagis.

https://www.openlosmolinos.es/

Some ideas that came to mind are:
A special discount code for the Valdepeñas event, ideally with an improved
commission structure.
A shared advertising budget, with both Chessnut and ChessMagis investing to
maximize the campaign's reach.
Promotion through Chessnut's official channels, if possible.

On our side, we are investing our own time, resources, showroom space,
content creation and advertising. We have also recently completed our
online store with almost 300 products, so although we will only bring a
selected range to the event, our goal is to drive online sales before,
during and after the tournament.

https://chessmagis.com/tienda/

These are simply our initial ideas. You know your products and marketing
possibilities much better than we do, so if you think there are other ways
we could work together more effectively, we would be delighted to hear your
suggestions.
Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,
Ginés
www.chessmagis.com

messages.name: Wade Higgins
messages.subject: Chessnut MOVE / Companion App Testing Feedback – Bugs Identified
messages.summary: Good morning Stella, I have been testing the app and will continue to do so over the coming days. During testing, I encountered the following issues. *08/07/2026 – MAIA Bot Mode (Chessnut Companion + Chessnut MOVE)* I tested MAIA Bot Mode by playing against MA
messages.body:
Good morning Stella,

I have been testing the app and will continue to do so over the coming
days. During testing, I encountered the following issues.

*08/07/2026 – MAIA Bot Mode (Chessnut Companion + Chessnut MOVE)*

I tested MAIA Bot Mode by playing against MAIA 3 using the Chessnut
Companion with the Chessnut MOVE.

*Issue 1 – Clock does not start correctly*

On the first move of the game, neither White's nor Black's timer started
correctly.

The expected behaviour is for White's clock to remain idle before the first
move. Once White makes the opening move, Black's clock should begin as the
game has officially started.

For this test the clock did not start until after black had made their
first move.

*Issue 2 – Increasing delay for chessnut MOVE movements*

Each MOVE activation became progressively more delayed as the game
continued.

After I made a move, the Companion would immediately acknowledge the move,
update the position, and switch the clock back to my side. However, the
physical piece would not begin moving straight away.

The delay increased each turn, for example:

-

Move 1 – No delay
-

Move 2 – No delay
-

Move 3 – Approximately 2 seconds
-

Move 4 – Approximately 3 seconds
-

Move 5 – Approximately 4 seconds

This continued throughout the game. By move 17, there was approximately a
16-second delay between the Companion acknowledging the move and the
Chessnut MOVE beginning to move the piece.

After completing the game, I pressed *Restart* to begin a new game. The
delay carried over into the new game as well. Black's first move took
approximately 12 seconds from the time the Companion acknowledged the move
and switched the clock back to me before the piece began moving.
------------------------------

*10/07/2026 – Career Mode / MAIA Difficulty (Chessnut PRO +
Chessnut Companion)*

After updating to the latest version, I tested Career Mode.

I noticed that the MAIA difficulty did not appear to increase between
games, despite my Career rating increasing.

To verify this, I exited Career Mode and entered MAIA Bot Mode, where I
manually selected different MAIA ratings. Regardless of the rating
selected, including the strongest setting of 2600, the bot continued to
play at what appeared to be the lowest difficulty level.

I tested this multiple times with different ratings, but the behaviour
remained the same.

I will continue testing next week.

Regards,
Wade

Joshua Rose

39201 Red Hawk Terr Apt. A308 Fremont, CA 94538 United States

Also, you're more than welcome to join as the "silent partner." :)

messages.summary: New support request from Chessnut website: Name: Giorgio Donnoli Email: developer@chesstools.it Order Number: N/A Inquiry Type: Business / Partnership Product: Chessnut Pro Description: Subject: ChessFlow — a new iOS training app built for Chessnut boards (lau
messages.body:
New support request from Chessnut website:

Name: Giorgio Donnoli
Email: developer@chesstools.it
Order Number: N/A
Inquiry Type: Business / Partnership
Product: Chessnut Pro

Description:
Subject: ChessFlow — a new iOS training app built for Chessnut boards (launching September)

Hi Chessnut team,

I'm Giorgio Donnoli, an iOS developer and active tournament chess player from Italy,
and I've spent the past year building an app designed from day one around your boards.

ChessFlow turns a Chessnut board into an opening repertoire trainer. You play your
prep on the real board; the app follows along with LED guidance and records every
move on an electronic scoresheet — the same gesture and mindset as a rated
tournament game. Under the hood it schedules each line with spaced repetition,
and when a training line ends you can play the position out against Stockfish
without leaving the board.

You can see it here, with real photos of the app running on an Air+:
https://www.chesstools.it/chessflow.html

ChessFlow launches on the App Store in September 2026, and it will be one of the
few third-party training apps that make owning a Chessnut board *more* valuable —
every ChessFlow user is a Chessnut customer, and the product page already tells
people which boards to buy.

Here's where you can help. All development so far has been on my own Chessnut
Air+. The BLE protocol should make the app work on the Go and the Pro as well,
but I won't advertise compatibility I haven't verified on real hardware — my
users will be tournament players, and they notice.

Would you be willing to provide one Chessnut Go and one Chessnut Pro as test
units? In return I'll certify and maintain full compatibility across the range,
list the supported boards prominently on the site and App Store page, and link
to your store as the place to get them. I'm also happy to share TestFlight
access so your team can try the app before launch, and to send structured
feedback on anything I find in the BLE layer along the way.

I'd love to make ChessFlow the training app Chessnut owners recommend to each
other. Shipping two boards is the cheapest marketing you'll buy this year.

Best regards,
Giorgio Donnoli
ChessTools — https://www.chesstools.it
developer@chesstools.it

Video Link: https://www.chesstools.it/chessflow.html

---
Submitted via Chessnut Contact Form

messages.summary: Dear Stella, Thank you for your thoughtful proposal and for taking the time to outline your vision for a long-term partnership. We truly appreciate the opportunity and believe this could be the beginning of a valuable collaboration between Chessnut and Al Ain
messages.body:
Dear Stella,

Thank you for your thoughtful proposal and for taking the time to outline
your vision for a long-term partnership.

We truly appreciate the opportunity and believe this could be the beginning
of a valuable collaboration between Chessnut and Al Ain Chess Club.

We are very interested in the product sponsorship model and the pre-order
distribution approach, especially as it allows us to introduce Chessnut
products to our community without the need to hold inventory.

Before moving forward, we would appreciate a few additional details
regarding:

- The products included in the sponsorship (models and quantities).
- The estimated annual value of the sponsorship.
- Whether shipping costs to the UAE are covered by Chessnut.
- The distributor margin and ordering process.
- Whether the partnership is intended to be annual and include support
for multiple tournaments and club activities throughout the year.

Once we have these details, we will be pleased to discuss the next steps
and work together to establish a successful long-term partnership.

We look forward to your response and are excited about the potential
opportunities this partnership can create for both Chessnut and Al Ain
Chess Club.

Best regards,

*Ammar Sbahi*Marketing & Events Coordinator

*Al Ain Chess & Mind Games Club*

Landline: +971 3 763 3387

Mobile: +971 56 207 1929

Al Ain - United Arab Emirates

Patrick

messages.summary: Dear Stella, Thank you for your thoughtful reply and for your interest in exploring a long-term collaboration with Al Ain Chess and Mind Games Club. Our vision is to build a long-term strategic partnership with Chessnut that supports the continued growth of ch
messages.body:
Dear Stella,

Thank you for your thoughtful reply and for your interest in exploring a
long-term collaboration with Al Ain Chess and Mind Games Club.

Our vision is to build a long-term strategic partnership with Chessnut that
supports the continued growth of chess in Al Ain and across the UAE.

We are looking for a partnership that combines both financial sponsorship
and product support. The financial sponsorship would help us organize
tournaments, youth programs, community events, marketing activities, and
improve the overall player experience. At the same time, we would be
delighted to incorporate Chessnut smart boards and other Chessnut products
into our tournaments, training sessions, and promotional activities.

At this stage, we are open to discussing different sponsorship models and
support levels. We would be pleased to hear Chessnut's recommendations
regarding both financial sponsorship and product support, based on what you
believe would be the best fit for a long-term partnership. We are confident
we can develop a collaboration that delivers value for both organizations.

In return, Chessnut would receive year-round brand exposure through:

- Logo placement on tournament banners, marketing materials, and event
backdrops.
- Recognition across our social media channels and promotional campaigns.
- Brand visibility at tournaments and club activities throughout the
year.
- The opportunity to showcase Chessnut products during events and allow
players and visitors to experience them firsthand.
- Recognition as an official strategic partner of Al Ain Chess Club.

We believe this partnership can create meaningful value for both Chessnut
and the growing chess community in the UAE, and If you feel it would be
helpful, we would be happy to schedule an online meeting to discuss the
partnership further.

Thank you once again, and I look forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,

New support request from Chessnut website:

Name: Kenny Olajide
Email: olajidekenny56@gmail.com
Order Number: N/A
Inquiry Type: Business / Partnership
Product: Other / Not sure

Description:
Kind greetings, Chessnut Team

I’ve been following your team’s work for some time and have been impressed by the evolution of the product, especially your expansion into the Playzone. It’s an exciting direction, and I’d love the opportunity to contribute.

I’m a Product Designer with a strong background in both chess and product development. Before transitioning into product design, I worked as a chess content editor at Chessable and Forward Chess. I later became the Founding Product Designer at ChessEver alongside my co-designer, Dammy, and have since contributed to SmallChess. We are currently designing at Endgame.ai.

I believe my experience, combined with my deep understanding of the chess ecosystem, would allow me to help create an even more polished, intuitive, and user-centered experience for your product.

I’d be delighted to discuss how I can contribute to your team. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Kenny Olajide

messages.body:
Hi Stella,

Thanks for your reply!

Yes, I’ve already gone through the API documentation and have started
working on the integration. The main blocker at the moment is that I can’t
properly develop and test the implementation without having a physical
Chessnut board.

If I had access to a developer unit, I’m confident I could complete the
integration and ship the feature within about a week.

Please let me know if it’s possible to provide a developer unit. I’d be
excited to bring Chessnut support to Chessis.

Best regards,
Nikhil

wrote:

> definitely open to supporting it.

> - Have you had a chance to review our open API documentation?

> works best on your end.
>
> Best,

messages.summary: Good afternoon Stella, I've been thinking about the intermediate course you asked me to create to complement the Beginner Course, and I wanted to run an idea by you that I think could strengthen both the course and the content we create around it. Rather than
messages.body:
Good afternoon Stella,

I've been thinking about the intermediate course you asked me to create to
complement the Beginner Course, and I wanted to run an idea by you that I
think could strengthen both the course and the content we create around it.

Rather than building the course entirely in isolation, I'd like to develop
it alongside a real student.

I have someone in mind who is around 600 Elo, approximately 30 years old,
is genuinely committed to improving, and is comfortable being on camera. My
plan would be to work with him over the next six months while I build the
course, meeting weekly or fortnightly as each new section is completed.

This would allow me to test every lesson before it's finalised, making sure
the concepts, exercises, and puzzles are challenging enough without
becoming discouraging. Having a real student progress through the material
would give us valuable feedback and help ensure the finished course is as
effective as possible.

I also think this could become a great proof-of-concept content series. We
could document his improvement throughout the project with regular updates,
creating an authentic story that follows a real student's learning journey.
Rather than simply promoting the finished course, we'd be able to show how
it was developed and the progress made along the way.

The footage from this project could also be repurposed into YouTube videos,
Shorts, social media content, course testimonials, and future marketing
material.

To make the experience as close as possible to what future students will
have, I was wondering what your thoughts would be on providing him with a
Chessnut EVO for the project. This would allow him to complete all of his
training over the board exactly as the course is intended, while naturally
showcasing the product throughout the series.

I think this approach would help us create a stronger intermediate course,
validate the lesson structure with a real student, and document a genuine
chess improvement journey.

I'd love to hear your thoughts.

Thanks,

Wade

messages.body:
Hi Stella,

Thanks for the detail, I like the affiliate structure and I’m happy to have
that as part of the deal.

But I don’t see a fixed fee mentioned for the streams themselves. That’s
the piece that matters most to me, the affiliate commission can sit on top
as a bonus, not replace it.
Could you share what you’re able to offer as a fixed rate for the 4 streams
a month?

Best,
Lena

There are no entry fees, and I am not making any profit from it. Tournament Format: It is a hybrid Grand Prix system consisting of 10 monthly editions . In each standalone edition, the top 3 players win prizes, and additional sponsor items are raffled among all participants. Concurrently, the top 30 players from each edition earn points toward a general Grand Prix standing. The biggest guaranteed prizes are reserved for the overall Top 6, alongside a separate raffle pool for active club members. Timeline: We kick off this Sunday, June 28 . Each subsequent edition will take place on the last Sunday of every month, concluding with the grand finale in March 2027 . Player Turnout & Registration: The event is officially hosted on the Chess.com Chess.com Events platform. Because of how the platform works, official player registration opens exactly one hour before the tournament starts. However, based on our club's active community size, we are expecting a very strong turnout. Exposure & Marketing: We have fantastic channels lined up! Chess.com Chess.com Polska has already published information about our tournament and will promote it again right before the launch. Additionally, Marianczello will be live-streaming parts of the tournament cycle (schedule permitting). We are also planning to include dedicated sponsor mentions and product placements directly inside Marianczello’s upcoming YouTube videos. Regarding your mention of co-creating content, could you please provide more details on what exactly you have in mind? Once I have more specifics, I will consult directly with Marianczello to see what formats we can best integrate into his channel. Please let me know if this structure aligns with Chessnut's goals, and we can discuss how to move forward! Best regards, Krzysztof Lead Organizer | MARIANCZELLO Club

Hi, That sounds perfect, I completely agree. Let's go ahead with this plan. Marianczello will be happy to create a dedicated Short/Reel with the board and include organic mentions in his future videos. Co-tagging on Instagram is also a great idea. Could you please send me the link to the specific product/board model we are talking about? I’d like to check out the details. In the meantime, here are the shipping details for the 3 boards: Krzysztof Dettlaff Ul.Ogrodowa 35 84-140 Jastarnia Polska Let me know if you need anything else to move forward. Best regards, Krzysztof Wystarczy, że uzupełnisz swoje dane adresowe w pogrubionym bloku i możesz wysyłać. Jeśli chcesz, żebym pomógł Ci przygotować coś jeszcze (np. krótki plan na tę rolkę/Shortsa , gdy już dostaniesz link i szachownicę), daj mi znać! messages.summary: Hi Stella, Thank you so much for your kind and motivating message. It really means a lot to me, and I'm very happy to hear that you've been following my progress closely! I am really happy with how the Tiktok and Instagram accounts are growing. No worries at a
messages.body:
Hi Stella,

Thank you so much for your kind and motivating message. It really means a
lot to me, and I'm very happy to hear that you've been following my
progress closely! I am really happy with how the Tiktok and Instagram
accounts are growing.

No worries at all regarding the tournament sponsorship. I just wanted to be
sure so that I could plan accordingly.

Regarding the agreement, yes, I can definitely commit to at least one piece
of content per day during the summer break. There may be a few rare
occasions where I can't post because of an important emergency, but overall
I'm happy with this goal. In fact, knowing that there are people supporting
me and following my journey also helps me stay consistent.

I can also confirm that the address and all the information are correct.
Thank you again! I'm really looking forward to trying the chess clock. If I
make a video about it, should I send you the link so you can promote it as
before?

Also can you explain to me how I can do a collaboration post with Chessnut
on instagram like you did with Swapnil, Rachel, etc? I would like to do
more posts like this to reach more people showcasing the boards but I'm not
sure how to do it.

And I'm not sure if you saw my WhatsApp message, but I was wondering if it
would be possible to get access to the photos from the tournament—both the
pictures of us with the Chessnut boards and the photos taken during the
games. I'd love to use some of them for profile pictures and social media
posts.

I also wanted to ask if you happen to have a more basic Chessnut T-shirt
available, maybe with just a small logo on it. If so, I'd love one!

Thank you again for all your support!

Best,
Tim

messages.summary: Hi Alan, Thank you very much for your reply, for taking the time to answer my questions, and for sharing the distributor price list along with the additional information. Regarding your comment, no offense taken at all. On the contrary, I completely understand
messages.body:
Hi Alan, Thank you very much for your reply, for taking the time to answer my questions, and for sharing the distributor price list along with the additional information. Regarding your comment, no offense taken at all. On the contrary, I completely understand your point of view. I have identified that this category could have significant potential in Mexico. That is precisely why I have decided to approach this project in a structured way. The information you shared will be an important part of my analysis, and I will complement it by validating the opportunity within the Mexican market. My objective is to ensure that every decision regarding this project is supported by real data rather than by an initial perception alone. I already have a specialized project defined, focused exclusively on smart chess. Its objective is to build a dedicated presence around this category, create valuable content, and measure the real response of the Mexican market. At the same time, I will also work on the logistics and import aspects to ensure that, if the project confirms the potential I have identified, it can be developed in a serious, professional, and sustainable way. Chess has been a personal passion of mine for many years, and for that reason I don't see this as a short-term opportunity, but as something I want to build with a long-term vision. I hope to get back in touch once I have meaningful progress to share. I look forward to showing you how the project evolves and continuing our conversation. Thank you again for your time, your openness, and all the information you have shared. Kind regards, David

hi David, no offense but it is quite a new area for you. some short answer/bkg for your reference 1. cert we cert FCC/CE which allowes us to sell in US/EU HS code: 9504903000 2. build price: see attached price list 3. logisic we do FOB china city and no consignee shipping mode accepted. you need logistic agent to cover. 4. warranty one year. br Alan alan.wang@chessnutech.com   发件人：   david@popokani.mx 发送时间：  2026-06-25 20:48 收件人：   alan.wang@chessnutech.com 抄送：   stella.zhuang@chessnutech.com 主题：  Re: Re：[Chessnut Support] Business / Partnership - Chessnut Move Hello Alan, Thank you for your reply. Yes, you have reached the correct company. I am the founder of Popokani, a Mexican company focused on importing and distributing specialized products. Our current business is primarily related to the RAW brand and its accessories, which is why that is the main focus shown on our website. However, for some time we have been evaluating the possibility of developing a new business category focused on specialized technology products, and Chessnut is one of the brands that has attracted our attention the most. In addition to my experience in international trade and import operations, I have been a chess enthusiast for many years and I understand the growing interest in smart chess products within the chess community. We have a structured process for evaluating new product categories before incorporating them into our portfolio. Our goal is to understand the entire value chain, from importation and regulatory compliance to commercialization and final customer sales. For this reason, we are requesting detailed technical and commercial information. Before evaluating distribution or sales strategies, we need to fully understand logistics, import requirements, technical documentation, transportation costs, and regulatory considerations. Since these are electronic products, we understand that the process is very different from simpler product categories, and we want to make sure everything is handled properly from the beginning. We are not looking to approach this as an improvised project. Our interest is to understand the category professionally and determine whether we can build a solid and sustainable operation around the Chessnut product line in Mexico. I also apologize for the number of questions. Our intention is simply to understand all legal, logistical, and commercial requirements before moving forward, ensuring that any future operation is carried out efficiently and in full compliance with Mexican regulations. Thank you again for your time and willingness to answer our questions. I look forward to receiving any additional information you can share regarding the Chessnut product line and distribution program. messages.summary: Hi Stella, it is Tim, I hope you're all doing well! Since I came back from Hong Kong, I've started posting 1–2 short videos per day featuring the Chessnut board, and the audience has been very receptive. Many people are asking in the comments whether I'm satis
messages.body:
Hi Stella, it is Tim,
I hope you're all doing well!

Since I came back from Hong Kong, I've started posting 1–2 short videos per
day featuring the Chessnut board, and the audience has been very receptive.
Many people are asking in the comments whether I'm satisfied with the
board, if it's worth the price, and other questions about my experience.

I've also noticed a significant increase in sales through my affiliate
code, with more than $8,500 in sales generated since I started this content
strategy.
I also wanted to share this video (https://youtu.be/RYZlPBa5ABc) with you
because it's the kind of content I was talking about regarding the
possibility of playing in the European Championship in Montenegro (9
videos).
Of course, the videos would be more focused on the board itself, with
commentary about the games and camera angles better suited to showcase the
board.
I think this type of content could work really well and bring even more
visibility to Chessnut. Would something like this be possible on your side?
Even partial support, for example covering the flight or the hotel, could
already make it feasible for me to attend.

And if it's not possible, please let me know as well so I can look for
another solution and plan accordingly.

Best, Tim

messages.summary: Hi Stella, My sincerest apologies for the delayed response. I had actually written this email before leaving for my trip on June 14th and thought I had sent it, but I just realized it was still sitting in my drafts and had not gone through. I’m very sorry abou
messages.body:
Hi Stella,

My sincerest apologies for the delayed response. I had actually written
this email before leaving for my trip on June 14th and thought I had sent
it, but I just realized it was still sitting in my drafts and had not gone
through. I’m very sorry about that.

It has also been an incredibly hectic couple of weeks as we prepare for our
summer camps, and I was out of the country until recently, so I’m just
catching up on everything now.

For now, here is the board information:

Model number: CM100
Serial number: CMB6300533
Charging port model number: CHGCM1

In terms of the pieces affected, it is a little difficult to identify each
specific piece, but I would say at least half of the pieces seem to be
affected.

I also wanted to mention that we have already begun putting out some basic
introduction videos about the Chessnut Move unit, and we also incorporated
it into our May 24th chess event, which was a huge success. Many parents
showed a lot of interest in the unit, and it was definitely something that
caught people’s attention.

That said, I have held off on creating a full review of the Chessnut Move
for the time being until we can hopefully resolve the issue. I’m very
grateful that Chessnut provided the unit, and there are many wonderful
features that I would be excited to highlight properly. At the same time, I
want to make sure that any review I share is fair, honest, and genuinely
useful for the families and chess players who follow us.

I think it is important that I speak accurately about the full experience,
including both the strengths of the unit and any practical notes around
setup, troubleshooting, or things that may still need to be addressed.

Also, for the videos we have shared so far, we did tag Chessnut. I just
wanted to ask whether you received our collaboration requests for those
videos. Going forward, when we feature the Chessnut Move unit, do you
prefer that we simply tag Chessnut, or would you prefer that we send
collaboration requests and post them as collab videos when appropriate?

I’ll do my best to send the short video once I’m able to properly test and
record the issue.

Thank you again for your help, and sorry again for the delayed response.
Arash Shahi "Mr. S"
Executive Director
CHESS WITH MR. S INC.

www.chesswithmrs.com
Mobile: 416.456.1599
info@chesswithmrs.com
shahiarash.s@gmail.com

Alternatively, we could also propose another option for the prize distribution: We could award 2 boards to the players (one for the final Grand Prix winner and one for the raffle), and the 3rd board could be shipped directly to the creator, Marianczello. This way, he will have the product on hand to record dedicated content and reviews about your brand. Please let me know which of these options works best for you!

Will they be awarded at the final Grand Prix standings, or distributed across individual events? - If there are other sponsors, will the Chessnut boards be presented as standalone prizes, or grouped together with other sponsor items? There are no entry fees, and I am not making any profit from it. Tournament Format: It is a hybrid Grand Prix system consisting of 10 monthly editions . In each standalone edition, the top 3 players win prizes, and additional sponsor items are raffled among all participants. Concurrently, the top 30 players from each edition earn points toward a general Grand Prix standing. The biggest guaranteed prizes are reserved for the overall Top 6, alongside a separate raffle pool for active club members. Timeline: We kick off this Sunday, June 28 . Each subsequent edition will take place on the last Sunday of every month, concluding with the grand finale in March 2027 . Player Turnout & Registration: The event is officially hosted on the Chess.com Chess.com Events platform. Because of how the platform works, official player registration opens exactly one hour before the tournament starts. However, based on our club's active community size, we are expecting a very strong turnout. Exposure & Marketing: We have fantastic channels lined up! Chess.com Chess.com Polska has already published information about our tournament and will promote it again right before the launch. Additionally, Marianczello will be live-streaming parts of the tournament cycle (schedule permitting). We are also planning to include dedicated sponsor mentions and product placements directly inside Marianczello’s upcoming YouTube videos. Regarding your mention of co-creating content, could you please provide more details on what exactly you have in mind? Once I have more specifics, I will consult directly with Marianczello to see what formats we can best integrate into his channel. Please let me know if this structure aligns with Chessnut's goals, and we can discuss how to move forward! Best regards, Krzysztof Lead Organizer | MARIANCZELLO Club

messages.body:
Hi Stella, Thanks for your message and the great ideas! Showing the physical Chessnut boards in the video is definitely a smart move to boost engagement. To answer your questions: Other Sponsors: Yes, we have other brand partners on board, all strictly related to chess. They are Chess.com Chess.com , Caissa, szachownica3d.pl szachownica3d.pl , Exclusive Sport, Marianczello Sklep, and Węgiel Chess. Prize Distribution: We plan to award the 3 Chessnut boards at the very end of the 10-tournament series. Two boards will go directly to the TOP 2 players in the final Grand Prix standings. The third board will be used for a giveaway raffle—anyone who participates in more than 50% of the tournaments (at least 6 out of 10) will be entered for a chance to win it. Presentation: In the official regulations and the prize section, your products will be clearly highlighted with the exact product name and your company logo, listed alongside the other sponsors. Regarding Content & Next Steps: To give you some context, I am managing the official Chess.com Chess.com club and the tournament logistics, while Maciej (Marianczello) is the creator and the face of the channel. To sum up from my end: I will ensure that your brand is highly visible to all players on Chess.com Chess.com throughout these few months of the series. As for the YouTube content, including the video timeline, it is open for discussion. I can certainly propose to Maciej that he records a dedicated Reel/Short featuring your products. To move forward, could you please send me a final summary of your expectations from Chessnut's side? Once I have your specific proposal, I will review it with Maciej and get back to you with our confirmation. Looking forward to collaborating with you! Best regards, Krzysztof Dettlaff Event Organizator and Admin Marianczello Club

messages.body:
Hello Alan, Thank you for your reply. Yes, you have reached the correct company. I am the founder of Popokani, a Mexican company focused on importing and distributing specialized products. Our current business is primarily related to the RAW brand and its accessories, which is why that is the main focus shown on our website. However, for some time we have been evaluating the possibility of developing a new business category focused on specialized technology products, and Chessnut is one of the brands that has attracted our attention the most. In addition to my experience in international trade and import operations, I have been a chess enthusiast for many years and I understand the growing interest in smart chess products within the chess community. We have a structured process for evaluating new product categories before incorporating them into our portfolio. Our goal is to understand the entire value chain, from importation and regulatory compliance to commercialization and final customer sales. For this reason, we are requesting detailed technical and commercial information. Before evaluating distribution or sales strategies, we need to fully understand logistics, import requirements, technical documentation, transportation costs, and regulatory considerations. Since these are electronic products, we understand that the process is very different from simpler product categories, and we want to make sure everything is handled properly from the beginning. We are not looking to approach this as an improvised project. Our interest is to understand the category professionally and determine whether we can build a solid and sustainable operation around the Chessnut product line in Mexico. I also apologize for the number of questions. Our intention is simply to understand all legal, logistical, and commercial requirements before moving forward, ensuring that any future operation is carried out efficiently and in full compliance with Mexican regulations. Thank you again for your time and willingness to answer our questions. I look forward to receiving any additional information you can share regarding the Chessnut product line and distribution program. Best regards, David Mitchel Rios Bernal Founder – Popokani david@popokani.mx

messages.body:
Hi Stella, I am the lead organizer and creator of this event, as well as the administrator of the MARIANCZELLO Club on Chess.com Chess.com . Marianczello and I are close friends; he was actually my very first chess coach. This entire cycle is being organized to celebrate his 10th anniversary as a content creator. To answer your questions directly: Role & Structure: I operate independently but with Marianczello's full backing. This is a non-profit project driven entirely by my passion to popularize chess. There are no entry fees, and I am not making any profit from it. Tournament Format: It is a hybrid Grand Prix system consisting of 10 monthly editions . In each standalone edition, the top 3 players win prizes, and additional sponsor items are raffled among all participants. Concurrently, the top 30 players from each edition earn points toward a general Grand Prix standing. The biggest guaranteed prizes are reserved for the overall Top 6, alongside a separate raffle pool for active club members. Timeline: We kick off this Sunday, June 28 . Each subsequent edition will take place on the last Sunday of every month, concluding with the grand finale in March 2027 . Player Turnout & Registration: The event is officially hosted on the Chess.com Chess.com Events platform. Because of how the platform works, official player registration opens exactly one hour before the tournament starts. However, based on our club's active community size, we are expecting a very strong turnout. Exposure & Marketing: We have fantastic channels lined up! Chess.com Chess.com Polska has already published information about our tournament and will promote it again right before the launch. Additionally, Marianczello will be live-streaming parts of the tournament cycle (schedule permitting). We are also planning to include dedicated sponsor mentions and product placements directly inside Marianczello’s upcoming YouTube videos. Regarding your mention of co-creating content, could you please provide more details on what exactly you have in mind? Once I have more specifics, I will consult directly with Marianczello to see what formats we can best integrate into his channel. Please let me know if this structure aligns with Chessnut's goals, and we can discuss how to move forward! Best regards, Krzysztof Lead Organizer | MARIANCZELLO Club

Is it 10 separate events with their own winners, or a points-based series leading to one overall champion? - Roughly how many players have registered so far? - You mentioned that 3 boards would help ‘create massive buzz across the 10-tournament cycle’ — could you clarify what the exposure channels look like? Are there social media promotions, media coverage, or other content formats? We’d also be open to co-creating content together. This will help us get a clearer picture and move forward more confidently. Best, Stella Business Development Manager | Chessnut ------------------------------------------------------------------ 发件人：krzysiekdettlaff@wp.pl <krzysiekdettlaff@wp.pl> 发送时间：2026年6月25日(周四) 15:05 收件人："stella.zhuang"<stella.zhuang@chessnutech.com> 主　题：Partnership X Marianczello Decade Series Dear Stella, Thank you for the quick response! I am very excited about your interest in collaborating. To give you more details about the event: I am the official organizer of the Marianczello Decade Series —a prestigious cycle of 10 tournaments celebrating Marianczello's 10th anniversary of chess content creation. He is the biggest chess YouTuber in Poland, with a community of over 150,000 subscribers and 50,000 members in our Chess.com Chess.com club. Initially, I mentioned a single board, but after finalizing the tournament structure, we would love to upgrade this to a partnership involving 3 Chessnut boards . This will allow us to create a massive buzz and maximize the marketing value for Chessnut across the entire 10-tournament cycle: 1st Board: The ultimate Grand Prix prize for the overall winner of the Decade Series. 2nd Board: The prize for the runner-up (2nd place) in the final standings. 3rd Board: A grand raffle prize for all participants. At the end of the series, we will host a big giveaway drawing from everyone who played, which is the perfect tool to keep everyday amateur players highly engaged and active from the first to the very last tournament. In exchange for these 3 boards, we will provide an extensive promotional campaign: Club Homepage Banner: A prominent Chessnut banner on our main Chess.com Chess.com club page for the entire duration of the series. Dedicated Articles & Newsletters: Official tournament announcements on Chess.com Chess.com with direct links to your store, sent to our 50,000 club members. YouTube Video Integration: Marianczello will personally provide dedicated sponsor shoutouts, mention your brand in his videos, and include direct links in the descriptions of his tournament coverage videos on YouTube. This setup ensures high, long-term player engagement and puts Chessnut products directly in front of thousands of passionate Polish chess players for months. Please let me know if this expanded package works for you! Best regards, Krzysztof Dettlaff Tournament Organizer www.chess.com https://www.chess.com/events/info/marianczello-decade-series m.youtube.com https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=41iJsK6L7mI 1:20 Last video and Youtuber talk about tournament and sponsors :)
